**About The Role

**Secomea builds secure remote access for industrial machines. Machine builders and manufacturers use our products to reach and service their equipment in the field without opening up the plant network. The portfolio runs from edge hardware (SiteManager) to our cloud platform, Secomea Prime.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager who has built identity and access capabilities in B2B SaaS. You will own identity and access across our portfolio: who can reach which machine, when, with whose approval, and how every session is recorded. You take it from the customer problem to adoption. You report to the Director of Product Management and work in a small team of product managers and UX designers & researchers.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Own discovery for your area. Talk to the people who buy and use our products: decision-makers at machine builders, distributors, IT and security leaders at end customers, service technicians, OT engineers and IT administrators. Turn what you learn into clear problem statements and outcomes.

• Decide on commercial grounds. Build the business case for your area (market potential, revenue impact, cost to build, margin) and back your priorities with usage data, win/loss insight and market analysis.

• Know the market. Track competitors, buying behaviour and technology shifts, and spot where Secomea can win.

• Run the roadmap. Plan your area 18 to 36 months ahead, with every theme tied to a customer outcome or a business metric.

• Work closely with engineering. Agree on scope and success criteria together. You own the what and the why; engineering owns the how and estimates the effort.

• Manage the full lifecycle. Weigh new capabilities against the health of live, mission-critical deployments. Set release support windows, end-of-life plans and migration paths for legacy products.

• Keep security and regulation in the plan. IEC 62443 (especially identification, authentication and use control), the EU Cyber Resilience Act and NIS2 shape requirements and release gates for our customers and for us.

• Measure the outcome. Define and track KPIs such as adoption, retention and time-to-value, and use them with customer feedback to decide what comes next.

• Get releases product-ready for go-to-market. Product Marketing owns pricing, packaging, enablement and launch communication. You give them the product input they need: what changes, for whom, why it matters, and the data behind it.

**What You Bring

**

• 6+ years in product management, with a substantial part on a B2B SaaS product.

• Product experience with identity and access management, for example single sign-on, user provisioning, role-based permissions, approval workflows or privileged access.

• Products you took from discovery to launch and kept improving.

• Ownership of a business case or revenue target, and an example of a decision that moved a commercial number.

• Comfort with data: you run your own analyses rather than wait for a report.

• Clear writing, and experience making a case with evidence to engineering, sales and leadership.

**Nice to have

**

• Experience with OT, industrial automation, Industrial IoT or remote access.

• Experience with products that combine cloud, software and hardware.

• Working knowledge of identity standards such as SAML, OIDC and SCIM.

• Working knowledge of IEC 62443, CRA or NIS2.

**This role is not for you if…

**

• You have never managed a B2B SaaS product. OT, hardware or security expertise alone is not enough for this role.

• You see product management as coordination, backlog administration or writing detailed user stories. Our PMs start at the customer problem, set the outcome, and work out the details with the team.

**Why join Secomea?

**At Secomea we rely on initiative and an open mindset, where your creativity and dedication come to use in an open and positive work atmosphere. As we are fast-growing and constantly expanding our business, you will have plenty of chances to grow your responsibilities and competencies while working at the heart of contemporary industrial tech.

We are a truly diverse company with offices placed across the globe, 30+ different nationalities, embracing all genders.

• Your own area. The product team is small, so you own your area end to end and your decisions show up in the product.

• Good timing. CRA and NIS2 raise the bar for remote access in industry, and AI is changing how access is audited and threats are detected. You will help decide how Secomea responds.

• An international team. More than 30 nationalities, with offices in Denmark, China, Japan and North America.

**How to apply

**In your application, describe one product decision you based on data and what it did to revenue, retention or cost.

**Our Story

**The world’s innovators, designers, engineers, builders and creators trust Autodesk to help them design and make a better world for all.

Autodesk’s Design and Make Platform empowers customers to transform how they work through cloud-connected technology, automation, AI, data and insights. From the buildings and infrastructure around us to the products we use and the entertainment that inspires us, Autodesk technology helps our customers design and make the world around us.

Our customers are navigating significant change, including sustainability pressures, labor and supply-chain challenges, rapid technological advancement and increasing digital complexity. Global Expansion Sales helps them unlock greater value from Autodesk by uncovering new opportunities, expanding adoption and connecting Autodesk solutions to their most important business priorities.

**Position Overview

****As an Account Executive in Global Expansion Sales, you will lead Autodesk’s growth strategy across a focused portfolio of assigned customers.

**You will operate as a senior business partner to the customer, bringing a hunter mindset to existing relationships: creating new demand, uncovering substantial whitespace, opening new buying centers and expanding Autodesk into strategic workflows, business units and transformation initiatives.

You will be expected to lead complex, high-value enterprise sales cycles, including seven-figure opportunities and multi-year commercial agreements, while orchestrating the broader Autodesk ecosystem around a common customer strategy. Success will be measured through sustained expansion growth, material pipeline creation, increased share of wallet, executive sponsorship, customer outcomes and forecast accuracy.

**Responsibilities

**

• Own and lead the multi-year growth and expansion strategy for assigned customers.

• Develop deep knowledge of each customer’s business model, strategic objectives, operating environment, industry dynamics and transformation agenda.

• Establish a clear point of view on where Autodesk can create differentiated business value for the customer.

• Identify significant whitespace across business units, geographies, workflows, technology estates, user communities and executive priorities.

• Create demand and originate large strategic opportunities, including seven-figure deals and opportunities that may not yet exist in the customer’s formal buying process.

• Build relationships across new buying centers while deepening trusted relationships with existing stakeholders.

• Develop C-suite and senior executive sponsorship across business and technology functions.

• Bring external market, industry and customer insight into executive conversations, with relevant knowledge of Autodesk’s Design and Make industries.

• Translate customer strategy into compelling multi-year value propositions, transformation roadmaps and business cases.

• Lead complex, high-value and potentially multi-year sales cycles involving multiple business, technical, procurement, finance and legal stakeholders.

• Develop and execute competitive strategies to win strategically significant new workloads and displace incumbent technologies.

• Navigate sophisticated commercial arrangements and seven-figure negotiations with strong business and financial acumen.

• Mobilize Autodesk’s executive leadership and broader organization around a unified account strategy.

• Orchestrate Technical Sales, Customer Success, Industry, Partners, Marketing, Professional Services and other specialists at the appropriate stages of the customer journey.

• Develop strategic ecosystem and partner relationships that increase Autodesk’s impact and relevance.

• Maintain executive-level governance around opportunities, risks, dependencies and account priorities.

• Apply account-planning, relationship-mapping, customer intelligence, forecasting and AI-enabled tools responsibly to support multi-year account strategy, executive engagement and opportunity governance.

• Maintain rigorous pipeline quality and deliver accurate, evidence-based forecasts.

• Represent the voice of the customer within Autodesk while bringing relevant Autodesk innovation, capability and thought leadership back to the customer.

**What Success Looks Like

**Sustained strategic revenue growth; creation and conversion of substantial new whitespace; increased Autodesk share of wallet; expansion into strategically important workloads and business initiatives; deep C-suite sponsorship; successful execution of seven-figure opportunities; strong multi-year account strategies; competitive displacement; measurable customer outcomes; and consistently high-quality forecasting.

**Minimum Qualifications

**

• Demonstrated success leading complex enterprise technology, SaaS, cloud or strategic software sales.

• Proven record of creating and closing significant opportunities within large, complex customer organizations, including experience with seven-figure deals or comparable commercial complexity.

• Demonstrated ability to create demand and develop major opportunities rather than simply manage an existing pipeline.[KS1]

• Strong C-suite presence with the ability to engage credibly on business, industry and transformation priorities.

• Exceptional strategic account-planning and whitespace-development capability.

• Strong business and financial acumen and ability to build compelling economic and strategic business cases.

• Experience leading sophisticated multi-stakeholder and multi-year sales processes.

• Strong competitive selling, negotiation and commercial leadership capability.

• Demonstrated ability to lead large virtual teams and influence senior stakeholders without direct authority.

• Exceptional communication, storytelling and executive presentation skills.

• High standards of commercial judgment, accountability, pipeline management and forecasting.

• Demonstrated fluency with CRM, strategic account-planning, relationship-mapping, pipeline and forecasting platforms. Experience with Salesforce, Clari, Altify or comparable platforms is valued.

**Preferred Qualifications

**

• Deep knowledge of a relevant Autodesk Solution Group industry - AEC, Manufacturing or Media & Entertainment - where appropriate to the assigned customer portfolio.

• Experience selling enterprise platforms, cloud technology or large-scale transformation solutions.

• Experience navigating complex multinational customer organizations.

• Demonstrated success developing multi-year executive relationships and transformation programs.

• Track record of strategic competitive displacement and significant share-of-wallet growth.

**How We Work At Autodesk

**At Autodesk, we work as One Autodesk and bring our One ORBIT values to life every day: Optimistic, Relentless, Brave, Ingenious and Trusted.

In this role, you will bring those values to life by leading as One Autodesk, bringing a bold and informed point of view to our customers, making smart decisions in complex environments, creating new possibilities and earning long-term trust at the highest levels of the customer organization.

**Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!

**Do you enjoy solving the data problems that are too hard to crack anywhere else?

**We collect and match pricing data from across the web, and it has to be complete, correct and fresh enough for our customers to act on. Some customer needs go beyond the standard setup: a new market to cover, tricky matching, data that's hard to get, or a customer-specific setup for a large enterprise deal. That's where you come in.

As Data Coordinator, you'll combine hands-on data engineering with ownership of complex data tasks and larger customer data projects, for both existing and prospective customers. And you'll help turn one-off solutions into processes and tools we can reuse across customers.

**About The Role

**You'll be part of our Product Success team and work closely with our Product Success Managers, GTM, our Solution Architect and colleagues across Product and Engineering.

You'll work on-site from our Aarhus HQ. English is our working language, and the team is international.

**Delivering data tasks and customer projects

**

• You'll maintain our data scrapers so collection stays accurate and tracking is uninterrupted.

• You'll translate requirements from Product Success and the Solution Architect into concrete technical work.

• You'll work on challenges around market coverage, data quality, matching, data availability and customer-specific setups.

• You'll own your tasks from technical investigation to quality-assured delivery, and keep stakeholders updated on progress, risks and changes.

**Investigating and solving

**

• You'll dig into data, processes and scraping issues to find the underlying cause and the right fix.

• You'll diagnose scraping bugs and turn them into actionable tasks for Engineering, and keep GTM informed when an incident affects customers.

• You'll extract, transform, validate and configure data with the right tools for the job.

• You'll document technical decisions, assumptions and completed solutions.

**Quality and scalability

**

• You'll validate accuracy, completeness, coverage and reliability before anything is delivered.

• You'll balance what a customer needs with what's technically feasible and maintainable in the long run.

• You'll spot recurring tasks and propose how to standardise, reuse or automate them.

**Owning the technical calls

**Within the priorities set by your manager, the technical decisions are yours: how to investigate and solve a task, which tools and methods to use, whether the requirements are clear enough to start, and which quality checks a delivery needs before it's done. When something needs input from Data, Product or Engineering, you pull in the right person.

You'll know you're succeeding when complex data deliveries land accurately and as agreed, risks are flagged early, and more of the recurring work becomes standardised or automated.

**What We're Looking For

**

• A background in data, e.g. from your education, projects or work, and you enjoy working hands-on with it.

• You know your way around Python, SQL or similar tools.

• An interest in web scraping and data extraction. Experience is a plus.

• You care about data quality and notice when something doesn't add up.

• You own a task from start to finish, and you clarify requirements before you start building.

• You communicate clearly with non-technical stakeholders, including commercial teams.

• You enjoy working in English in an international team.

**What You Can Expect From Us

**

• Empowered collaboration: Work closely with GTM, Product and Engineering.

• Support and development: Regular coaching and feedback.

• Room to experiment: An environment where curiosity, testing and learning are expected.

• An international workplace: Colleagues from 24+ nationalities across disciplines and markets.

• Flexibility and balance: Flexible working hours, social activities, pension, health insurance and modern offices in Aarhus and Stockholm.

**PriceShape is a global leader in competitor monitoring and dynamic pricing. Our platform helps brands and online retailers track vendors' prices, stock availability, and trends while implementing tailored pricing strategies.

We’re a diverse team of 80 employees from 24 nationalities, working from a modern, centrally located office in Aarhus C. We prioritize work-life balance, trust, community and focus on personal and professional growth opportunities.

We offer flexible hours, social events, pension and health insurance, great work facilities and an in-house canteen.

**Bring your laboratory expertise to a team supporting life-changing therapies

**At AGC Biologics in Søborg, our QC Bioassay team plays an important role in ensuring the quality of biopharmaceutical products developed and manufactured for patients around the world.

As QC Bioassay continues to grow, we are looking for a Senior Laboratory Technicians to join our team. You will work with specifically in our dedicated Cell-Based Assay Team, support daily laboratory activities, and contribute to analytical testing throughout different stages of pharmaceutical production.

You will join an international and collaborative environment where skilled colleagues work closely together, share knowledge, and support each other in delivering high-quality results.

**Where your laboratory work makes a difference

**As a Senior Laboratory Technician in QC Bioassay, you will be involved in analytical testing of drug substance, drug product, and in-process samples. Your work will also include stability programs and method validations for both early-stage and commercial products.

You will work with complex bioanalytical methods and contribute to developing, establishing, and improving robust assays. Your experience and technical understanding will be important when troubleshooting methods and supporting their continued improvement.

**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Performing Cell-Based Assays.

• Conducting analytical testing of drug substance, drug product, and in-process samples.

• Reporting results, including data processing and setup in LIMS.

• Participating in method validation studies, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of analytical methods.

• Ensuring timely testing of stop/go samples to support our manufacturing facility.

The role offers the opportunity to work with a variety of cell-based potency methods, contribute to their development and optimization, and support both clinical and commercial manufacturing activities.

**A collaborative team with broad analytical expertise

**QC Bioassay is one of five departments within our QC organization at AGC Biologics in Søborg.

Our department consists of 51 skilled Scientists and Technicians, organized into four groups: Bioassay Technicians, Bioassay Scientists, Bioassay Cell-Based, ELISA & Reference Material, and General Analytics.

In your immediate team, you will work alongside five Technicians and four Scientists, with opportunities for technical sparring, mentoring, and knowledge sharing.

Together, we perform a broad range of compendial methods, bioassays, and cell-based assays. Our responsibilities include method validations for early and late-stage products, release testing of clinical and commercial batches (DS and DP), and testing of stability samples.

We also support our 24/7 manufacturing operations through the testing of in-process stop/go samples.

You will become part of an international and diverse team with an informal working environment, where close collaboration, knowledge sharing, and supporting new colleagues are important parts of our daily work.

**Bring Your Technical Skills And Structured Approach

**We are looking for a colleague with a degree as a Laboratory Technician (Laborant), ideally combined with at least four years of relevant laboratory experience from an industrial, development, or QC environment.

Experience working in a GMP-regulated laboratory is particularly important, as all our testing is performed according to cGMP.

Hands-on experience with Cell-Based assays is especially valuable for this position. Experience with other bioanalytical methods, including ELISAs, will also be an advantage, although experience with every method is not a requirement to apply.

Our corporate language is English, and you must be fluent in both written and spoken English.

To succeed in the role, you will benefit from a structured approach to your work and the ability to maintain quality when priorities change or deadlines are tight. You enjoy working with complex analytical methods, identifying opportunities for improvement, and collaborating with colleagues to establish reliable and robust solutions.

Good communication skills and a service-minded attitude are also important, as you will collaborate with colleagues across QC and with stakeholders, primarily from Manufacturing.

**Become part of an international QC organization

**We offer a permanent, full-time positions of 37 hours per week at our facility in Søborg.

Together with your colleagues, you will cover the daily laboratory activities, including weekend shifts once or twice a month, depending on the schedule.

You will have the opportunity to gain broad insight into how a QC Bioassay department operates within an international Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), while working alongside experienced colleagues in a collaborative environment.

At AGC Biologics, our work is guided by six core values: Knowledge, Trust, Quality, Ingenuity, Accountability, and Teamwork. These values connect our colleagues across three continents and support our shared purpose of bringing hope to life for patients around the globe.

**Join our QC Bioassay team

**Does this sound like your next career opportunity?

We would be pleased to receive your application. Simply apply with your CV through our recruitment system.

We will contact relevant candidates as applications are received and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, aiming for a start date as soon as possible.

**Who We Are

**AGC Biologics is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization with a strong presence in Denmark. From our Søborg site, we develop and manufacture life‑changing advanced biologics for some of the world’s most innovative pharmaceutical companies. Together with our team members across Europe, the U.S., and Japan, we deliver development and manufacturing of mammalian and microbial-based therapeutic proteins, plasmid DNA (pDNA), messenger RNA (mRNA), viral vectors, and genetically engineered cells therapies. Across our global network, we are united by one mission: To work side by side with our customers in order to improve patients’ lives by bringing new biopharmaceuticals to market.

Job Purpose We are seeking a highly experienced and hands-on Senior Optical Design Engineer to develop high-end optical products and technologies from customer requirements through optical design, prototyping, manufacturing, and final qualification.

This is a highly flexible and varied role where priorities evolve as projects develop. One day you may be designing and tolerancing a sophisticated optical system in Zemax; the next you may be developing Matlab or Python algorithms to diagnose a problem in a high-end CNC machining process, designing an optical measurement system, or working hands-on in the laboratory with production engineers. The ideal candidate is a strong optical designer as well as a curious, analytical, and pragmatic engineer who enjoys solving difficult problems across traditional engineering boundaries.

Job Duties & Responsibilities

• Optical & Lens Design: Perform optical system and lens design using Zemax, including tolerancing, sensitivity analysis, optimization, and design for manufacturability.

• System Integration: Translate customer requirements into practical optical solutions (imaging systems, non-imaging systems, precision opto-mechanical assemblies) with assembly, alignment, and measurement in mind.

• Advanced Optical Techniques: Design and apply strategies involving holography, interferometry, computer-generated holograms (CGHs), and compensation strategies.

• Lab & Production Diagnostics: Build and commission optical test systems, analyze measurement data, and conduct hands-on laboratory work to troubleshoot complex optical and manufacturing issues.

• Software Development: Write custom algorithms, models, and analysis tools using Matlab and/or Python to interface with optical design and measurement systems or support manufacturing processes.

• Cross-Disciplinary Collaboration: Work closely with mechanical, manufacturing, software, and process engineers, and participate in customer meetings to clarify specs and present designs.

Education & Experience

• MSc or PhD in Optical Engineering, Physics, or a related technical discipline with a strong emphasis on classical optics.

• Minimum 5 years of professional experience in optical design and development.

• Deep, practical knowledge of geometrical optics, aberrations, diffraction, imaging, and illumination.

• Demonstrated ability to build optical test setups, perform hands-on experimentation, and connect simulation results with real-world physical measurements.

• Strong mathematical and programming skills (Matlab/Python) to develop custom tools rather than rely solely on existing off-the-shelf software.

• Excellent communication skills, with comfort collaborating across fast-paced, fast-changing, and multicultural environments (including teams in Denmark and China).

• Advantage: Experience with CGHs, lithographic optics, holography, precision optical manufacturing, CNC/production process integration, photonic interconnects, photonic integrated circuits (PIC)

What We Offer

• High degree of responsibility and variety working on high-end precision optics.

• A role that bridges optical design, experimental optics, custom software development, metrology, and advanced manufacturing.

• Close collaboration with experienced international teams solving complex technical problems where conventional solutions fall short.

In addition to your CV, please include answers to the following two questions (should be included in your uploaded cover Letter):

1. Optical engineering challenge — 500–1,000 characters

Please describe one technically challenging optical engineering problem that you personally solved. Briefly explain:

• The problem and requirements – What were you trying to achieve, and what made the problem technically challenging?

• Your personal contribution – What did you personally do, including any optical design, simulation, programming, experimental work, or other engineering activities?

• The outcome – What was the result, and what did you achieve?

Please focus on a specific example from your own experience rather than describing a general project or team achievement.

2. Use of AI in engineering — 100–300 words

Please describe how you currently use artificial intelligence (AI) to solve or support development tasks in your present position. Give one or more concrete examples of how you use AI in your engineering work, and briefly explain what value it provides.

We are interested in your actual hands-on use of AI, rather than general views or opinions about the technology.

People Manager for Library – Aarhus

Be a People Manager for experienced developers and help libraries across Europe strengthen the way they work. Join a business unit in fast growth that constantly wins new markets.

The job

As a People Manager, you will be the direct people manager for 10-15 experienced developers across Aarhus, and you coach teams in the Cicero Product Development organisation. Your primary task will be to make sure people feel supported and motivated, and to help the teams become better as a team.

On a personal level, you:

Senior ERP Systems Consultant – AX 2012 & D365 F&O

Mission

**Do you want to take ownership of two generations of ERP systems at the world’s leading maritime supplier of provisions and stores?**Do you have strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics AX 2012 and the ambition to play a key role in supporting our current platform while contributing to our transition to D365 F&O? Are you motivated by ensuring system stability and continuous improvement while helping shape the future of our ERP landscape?

If you are a technically strong ERP systems consultant who enjoys solving complex issues, collaborating across IT and the business, and building new capabilities for the future, this could be the opportunity for you.

Become part of our ERP team in Nørresundby, DenmarkReporting to our Team Lead, Thomas Jørsfeldt, you will become part of our ERP team, working closely with business consultants, developers, architects, integration specialists and stakeholders across our international organisation.

As a Senior ERP Systems Consultant, your initial focus will be our existing Microsoft Dynamics AX 2012 platform, where you will ensure system stability, performance, technical quality and continuous improvement. As we transition from AX 2012 to D365 F&O, your role will evolve alongside our ERP landscape.

jobs.description:
Most companies that do conferencing hand you one slice of it. The desktop app, or the media pipeline, or, maybe, the join flow. Everything else you pass over a wall to another team. Not in this case. One team owns the whole path across the Airtame platform: Airtame 3, Airtame Go, Virtual Airtame, and browser, desktop, and mobile apps that go with them. The bar remains at an effortless experience. Someone walks into a room, and starts sharing. No app to hunt for, no login to chase.

The team is four engineers, and we're hiring their technical and people lead: someone who spends about 60% of time hands-on with the hardest problems, and the rest growing the engineers around them.

**About Airtame

**We're around 55 people, headquartered in Copenhagen, and you'd work from there or remotely from within the EU. We make the hardware and the software that runs on it, so a call you make about the streaming stack ends up in a product bolted to a wall in meeting rooms around the world. The team is small, works across disciplines, and reaches a global market from a small base.

Year one outcomes

Make joining a call one step that works. Today, getting an authenticated meeting started from a room takes too many turns: personal logins, manual entry, a different quirk on every platform. A year from now, starting a scheduled call on Teams, Zoom, Google Meet, or Webex should be something a room just does. Judge it by how often it works on the first try, and how rarely it reaches support.

Take the friction out of screen sharing. The browser path loses first-time users: too many clicks, not enough signposting. You'll own getting a newcomer from a short code to their screen on the wall without a stumble, and getting Miracast and AirPlay stable enough to turn on by default.

Make it behave the same everywhere. The experience varies between Airtame 3, Virtual Airtame, browser, desktop, and mobile today. By year-end, sharing and calling should feel like one product no matter which surface you're on, with real-time quality that holds up on whatever network the room happens to have.
